sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS 6G Security, Trust & Privacy Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.

sections.title: What this is
sections.body: Research and teaching lab for **target wireless communications engineering programs**-aligned skills — built as an independent portfolio project.

sections.title: Why wireless engineering readiness cares
sections.body: Threat models for O-RAN, AI-RAN, edge telemetry, digital twins.

sections.title: Commands
sections.body: make install && make test && make e2e

methods: Methods are the lists returned by src/gunnchos_6g_security: STRIDE, AI-RAN risks, privacy controls, and the O-RAN risk phrases. The O-RAN phrases are strings in oran_security.py, not an E2 or xApp topology. No attack was executed for this page.
